source.water: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), water bodies of 1 ha or more inside Israel’s district boundaries (Planning Administration, non-statutory)
source.rules: TAMA 1 s. 5.2.6 (PV on reservoirs and fish ponds) and Annex B'10, consolidated text, Planning Administration, July 2026
source.yield: PVGIS-SARAH3 at 10° tilt, nearest 0.05° cell within 15 km

note: Indicative scenario: 30% of the water surface at about 1.2 MWp per covered hectare. The actual extent needs the Water Authority and Ministry of Health (reservoirs) or the Ministry of Agriculture (fish ponds), plus an engineer’s stability approval.
